title: Multimedia
subtitle: game screenshots and clips
tmpHint: Temporary clips: they are deleted at shutdown unless you save them. The cache keeps at most 3.
emptyDesc: While playing, press Share for a screenshot, hold it to record a clip.
shareNoProviders: No service accepts this kind of content.
shareNotConnected: Not connected · A to sign in
shareNotConfigured: Not configured: {{vars}} missing from the daemon's .env (see INSTALL.md)
shareMore: More services are added in src/backend/share/providers/

shareNotes.youtube-private-only: Private videos only: Google's limit for unverified apps. Make them public from YouTube Studio.

loginSub: No passwords on the TV: you sign in from your phone
loginStep1a: Scan the QR code, or open

loginStep3.default: Choose the account and authorize X-Launcher
loginStep3.youtube: Choose the channel's Google account and authorize X-Launcher (if Google warns the app isn't verified: Advanced → Go to…)

loginWaiting: Waiting for sign-in on your phone…
shareKeyboardHint: You can also type with a physical keyboard

shareErr.not-configured: Service not configured: credentials missing from the daemon's .env (see INSTALL.md).
shareErr.invalid-client: Invalid OAuth client: it must be of type "TVs and Limited Input devices" (see INSTALL.md).
shareErr.no-channel: The chosen Google account has no YouTube channel.
shareErr.api-disabled: YouTube Data API v3 is not enabled in the Google Cloud project (see INSTALL.md).
shareErr.scope-not-granted: Permission to manage the channel was not granted.
shareErr.no-refresh-token: Google did not return a lasting sign-in: try again.
shareErr.busy: Another upload is already running: wait for it to finish.
shareErr.source-missing: The file is no longer available.
shareErr.unsupported: This service doesn't accept this kind of content.
shareErr.not-connected: The account is no longer connected: go back and sign in again.
shareErr.quota: The Google Cloud project's daily upload quota is used up: try again tomorrow.
shareErr.upload-limit: The channel's upload limit has been reached: try again later.
shareErr.bad-request: The service refused the post data (title or description).
shareErr.watermark-failed: The watermark could not be applied: try again without it (details in the daemon log).

uploadBackgroundHint: You can close this window: the upload continues in the background and the result arrives as a notification.
resultQrHint: Scan the code to open the video on your phone.

resultPrivate.youtube: The video is private: only you can see it until you make it public from YouTube Studio.

retryErr.job-expired: The upload can no longer be repeated (the daemon restarted): share again from Multimedia.
retryErr.source-missing: The file is gone (temporary clip discarded or deleted): nothing to repeat.
retryErr.busy: Another upload is already running: try again when it ends.
retryErr.not-connected: The account is no longer connected: sign in again from Share.

textBytesOver: {{name}} accepts at most {{max}} bytes (accented letters count as 2): the last {{over}} bytes will be cut.
alreadySharedCompose: This content was already shared on {{name}} on {{date}}: sharing it again creates a second copy.
watermarkOn: On · bottom right of the video · A to turn off
preparingHint: re-encoding the clip, then the upload
